Markets.title: Peter Cundill’s investing lessons: Why patience, research and value matter in stock picking
Markets.summary: Value investor Peter Cundill's philosophy focused on buying undervalued stocks with a margin of safety through thorough research and patience. His approach highlights fundamental analysis, clear criteria, investment journals, and reassessing decisions when facts change to build long-term wealth.

Markets.title: FIIs dump Indian stocks for eight straight weeks: Is a reversal on the cards or more pain ahead?
Markets.summary: Foreign institutional investors sold Indian stocks for the eighth consecutive week by offloading Rs 30,294 crore, while domestic institutional investors absorbed the impact with Rs 30,313 crore in purchases. A sustained market recovery depends on key factors including elevated crude oil prices, rupee weakness, and global bond yields.

Markets.title: Canara HSBC Life Q2 profit rises 5% YoY to Rs 43 crore
Markets.summary: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company reported a 5 percent increase in net profit to Rs 43 crore for the September quarter compared to Rs 41 crore last year. Total income grew to Rs 2,511 crore, alongside increases in net premium collections and first-year premiums.

Markets.title: RBI to conduct Rs 25,000 cr OMO sale auction of government securities on Oct 13
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will auction Rs 25,000 crore in government securities on October 13 across six maturities ranging from 2030 to 2034. This Open Market Operation aims to manage the banking sector's current surplus liquidity of approximately Rs 3.88 lakh crore.

Markets.title: RBI to sell $2.6 billion of bonds, tighten bank reserve need to squeeze cash
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will sell $2.6 billion in bonds and enforce a stricter cash reserve ratio on banks starting October 16 to reduce system liquidity. This move follows the RBI's first key interest rate hike in nearly four years, signaling potential future increases.

Markets.title: 8 midcap stocks rally up to 135% in a year; 2 turn multibaggers

Geo-Political.title: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump is pursuing a deal with Russia to help lower fuel prices ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. His administration faces mounting political pressure to ease the financial burden on his party.

Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation uses easy-to-read charts to provide data-driven insights into top stories reported by Mint. The topics covered this week include interest rate hikes, SIP flows, and Airtel's tariffs.

Data & Insights.summary: Chief economic adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has urged the government to adapt loan overdue rules to fit the real cash-flow cycles of MSMEs. He stated that regulators should avoid using rigid, uniform global standards for these businesses.

Data & Insights.summary: The European Union and China reached an agreement to significantly reduce hybrid car exports to the bloc. This deal is intended to ease mounting trade tensions between the two regions.

Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is launching a ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund to provide equity capital to small and medium businesses. This funding will help these enterprises expand their capacity, adopt new technology, and compete on a global scale.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council Meeting Oct 2026: List of decisions taken - arrest, prosecution, general penalty and more
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting in October 2026 eliminated arrest powers for officers and raised the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore. Key reforms also included reduced penalties, faster refunds, and simplified registration processes.

India.summary: Opposition leaders including Mamata Banerjee, Arvind Kejriwal, and P Vijayan were detained during a protest near Delhi's Jantar Mantar. Several other opposition and student leaders were also taken into custody while attempting to join the demonstration.

India.title: "Work Will Move To India's Talent Base": NASSCOM Chief On US Green Card Row
